en.title: Foundations Regulations Schedule 3: fine row "6(6)" for failing to give a copy of an assignment; the duty and the fine are in s.6(7)
en.summary: Row "6(6) Person failing to provide a copy of assignment of rights - 1,500". s.6(6) only permits assignment of rights if the By-laws allow. The duty to give the Registrar a copy within 30 days, with "liable to a fine, as set out in Schedule 3", is s.6(7). Amendments No. 3 (2023) itself quotes 6(7) as the fine provision. The description in the row matches 6(7).
